## Dart Formatting Standards

- Use `dart format` as the single authority on code formatting — **NEVER** manually adjust formatting to override its output.
- Always add trailing commas to function parameters, argument lists, collection literals, and widget constructors that span multiple lines.
- Order import directives in three groups separated by blank lines: `dart:` core libraries first, `package:` external dependencies second, relative project imports third.
- Sort imports alphabetically within each group — configure your IDE to organize imports on save.
- Run `dart format --set-exit-if-changed .` in CI pipelines — block merges on any formatting violation.
- Use `dart format --line-length=80` (Dart default) unless the team has explicitly agreed on an alternative — **NEVER** mix line lengths across files.
- Place `export` directives in a separate section after all import statements.
